map_readings.label: CANTELON 8400 - (8124.03): Discontinue and Close Section 0+000 to 1+861
map_readings.shows: Legend text for the road drawn with a yellow outline and blue dashes on this page, the section to be discontinued and closed. The road number printed along the highlighted road is partly covered by the highlight and cannot be read in full.
Label on a green active forest road; one end of the highlighted section meets this green road.

map_readings.label: EIGHT MILE 5700 - (8144.02): Discontinue and Close Section 0+000 to 0+700
map_readings.shows: Legend text for the road drawn with a yellow outline and blue dashes on this page, the section to be discontinued and closed. The road number printed along the highlighted road is partly covered by the highlight and cannot be read in full.
Label on a separate green active forest road running beside the highlighted section; one end of the highlighted section meets the green road line.

map_readings.label: ELEVEN MILE – (9352.01): Discontinue and Close Section 0+000 to 3+580
map_readings.shows: Legend text for the road drawn with a yellow outline and blue dashes on this page, the section to be discontinued and closed. One end of the highlighted road meets a highway drawn in beige with route shields. The road number printed along the highlighted road is partly covered by the highlight and cannot be read in full.

map_readings.label: SOUTH AINSLIE TWO – (9703.02): Discontinue and Close Section 0+000 to 2+418
map_readings.shows: Legend text for the road drawn with a yellow outline and blue dashes on this page, the section to be discontinued and closed. One end of the highlighted road meets a green road near the printed labels R09448 4 and R01673 SA130-1; the other end stops with no road beyond it. The road number printed along the highlighted road is partly covered by the highlight and cannot be read in full.

map_readings.label: CANTELON 8400 - (8124.03): Discontinue and Close Section 0+000 to 1+861
map_readings.shows: Exhibit A map: one road drawn as a highlighted (yellow-outlined, blue dashed) section, labelled along the line with a partly hidden road number; it runs from a junction with the green active road labelled 8124 01 near Cantelon Creek to its end. Another active road labelled 8124 12 is nearby. No gate symbols or km labels on the line.

map_readings.label: EIGHT MILE 5700 - (8144.02): Discontinue and Close Section 0+000 to 0+700
map_readings.shows: Exhibit A map: one road drawn as a highlighted (yellow-outlined, blue dashed) section, labelled along the line with a partly hidden 8144 number; it runs below and roughly parallel to the green active road labelled 8144 01 and R22468 EM1002. No gate symbols or km labels on the line.

map_readings.label: ELEVEN MILE – (9352.01): Discontinue and Close Section 0+000 to 3+580
map_readings.shows: Exhibit A map: one road drawn as a highlighted (yellow-outlined, blue dashed) section, labelled along the line with a partly hidden 9352 01 number; it starts at a highway and runs south of Eleven Mile Creek toward the area of the green active road labelled R22903 EM1120. Other active roads labelled R17046 WB209-1, 10486 01, R22903 EM3600 and R22903 EM3610 are nearby. No gate symbols or km labels on the line.

map_readings.label: SOUTH AINSLIE TWO – (9703.02): Discontinue and Close Section 0+000 to 2+418
map_readings.shows: Exhibit A map: one road drawn as a highlighted (yellow-outlined, blue dashed) section, labelled along the line with a partly hidden 9703 02 number; it starts at a junction with green active roads labelled R09448 4 and R01673 SA130-1 and runs to its end. Other active roads labelled R09448 1000 and R09448 3 are nearby. No gate symbols or km labels on the line.
